question: In a code language, GODOWN is written as IQFQYP and TRUNK is written as VTWPM. How will BOXES be written as in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/674ff9d0c426752547c8381166ab88a8c50e394fa9cb60d9855d0299ada567a7.png] 

The logic followed here is:

GODOWN is written as IQFQYP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3110fcf3137d08e409d075d6399dc22cc0cd196374e78f92392bf390c1a0d2ce.png] 

TRUNK is written as VTWPM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee69f889fdd11e8ffb5b1891f8bcf354e276ec324c5a4dc1f06fd562bc4177e2.png] 

Similarly, for **BOXES **be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd64957087d693de74504d5aa4d0ae219a69115c34189e0960aedf8c6e26402c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
